Florentine Families interactive supplement

Open florentine-families-demo.html in a browser. The file is self-contained.
The data and all illustrations are embedded; no server is required.
Share this HTML file and retain its visible Citations and data reuse section.
The accompanying data.json supplies the adapted data separately in a machine-
readable format, with source, changes and license information included.

Research reference
Padgett, John F., and Christopher K. Ansell. 1993. Robust Action and the Rise
of the Medici, 1400-1434. American Journal of Sociology 98(6), 1259-1319.
https://doi.org/10.1086/230190

Data provider
CoMuNe Lab / Manlio De Domenico.
Padgett-Florentine-Families Multiplex Network.
https://github.com/CoMuNeLab/Padgett-Florentine-Families

Data licensing
The original and adapted database are available under ODbL 1.0.
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/
Rights in individual contents are licensed under DbCL 1.0.
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/dbcl/1-0/
Preserve attribution and license notices. Any publicly shared derivative
database remains under ODbL; provide the adapted data in machine-readable
form. The JSON included here serves that purpose for this version.

Changes
Expanded family labels, rescaled graph coordinates and repositioned the
isolated Pucci node. Relationship data retained. The Florence illustration
is schematic and does not locate family residences. This small teaching
network is not the complete network analyzed in the 1993 article.

The interface and original schematic illustration are credited separately
to Keith A. Preble / Engaged Thinking, 2026. No ownership of the underlying
research data is claimed. The database licenses do not designate a license
for the separately created interface code or illustrations.
